appliedUpdates.description: Added .factory/library/hook-bundle-architecture.md to document that hook output fields (updatedInput, suppressOutput) must be forwarded through bash-pretool-bundle.cjs.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the scrutiny-validator skill procedure to not mandate running the generic `test` command from services.yaml. AGENTS.md explicitly states that `pnpm test` times out, which causes validators to either fail or deviate from procedure. The skill should allow targeted testing or rely on specific fast test commands.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features bash-updated-input and denial-routing-feedback both flagged that running the generic test suite times out as warned in AGENTS.md, causing procedural deviations.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Consider pointing `commands.test` to a faster test suite (e.g., `pnpm test:framework`) instead of the full `pnpm test` to avoid timeouts for generic validators.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features bash-updated-input and denial-routing-feedback both flagged that the default test command times out.
